versions.content: On reception of the UDS Service RoutineControl (0x31), for every requested RID inside the OBD range (E000-E0FF), the Dcm module shall handle the RID as defined for OBD Service $08 (see [SWS_Dcm_00418], [SWS_Dcm_00947], [SWS_Dcm_00419], [SWS_Dcm_00420], [SWS_Dcm_00948], [SWS_Dcm_01192]) if DcmDspEnableObdMirror is set to true and RID not explicitly configured.
